// 与 merge.go.txt 的客户端连接辅助一起编译；后者的 main 仅改名，业务请求仍走正式 PB/TCP。
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	player "DRILL_MODULE/game/entities/player"
	"DRILL_MODULE/loadtest/playertcp"
	"DRILL_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"DRILL_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	svcaccount "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/account"
)

func main() {
	playertcp.MustRegister()
	// 客户端不启动服务 bootstrap；这里只登记生成 Player 声明的 kind/category 以编码 Mongo 主键。
	entity.MustRegisterEntityKindCategory(player.EntityKindPlayer, entity.EntityCategoryPlayer)
	if len(os.Args) < 2 {
		panic("rehome drill command required")
	}
	command := os.Args[1]
	if err := flag.CommandLine.Parse(os.Args[2:]); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := rehomeCommand(ctx, command); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "rehomedrill:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func rehomeCommand(ctx context.Context, command string) error {
	client, stop, err := accounts()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer stop()
	if command == "setup" {
		open := "rehome-" + strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano(), 36)
		account, err := client.Login(ctx, svcaccount.Identity{Channel: "demo", OpenID: open, Credential: "demo:" + open})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		r, err := client.CreateRole(ctx, account.ID, 1000, "r"+open[len(open)-10:])
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		c, _, err := enter(ctx, client, account.ID, r.PlayerID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer c.raw.Close()
		count, err := addItems(c, 10)
		if err != nil || count != 10 {
			return fmt.Errorf("initial bag=%d: %v", count, err)
		}
		full, err := entity.BuildEntityID(r.PlayerID, player.EntityKindPlayer)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		s := state{Users: map[string]*user{"u": {OpenID: open, Account: account.ID, Roles: []*role{{SID: 1000, PlayerID: r.PlayerID}}}}}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(s)
		if err = os.WriteFile(*statePath, raw, 0600); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"player_id": r.PlayerID, "entity_id": strconv.FormatInt(full, 10)})
	}
	*who = "u:1000"
	u, r, err := whom()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command == "binding" {
		binding, err := client.RoleBinding(ctx, r.PlayerID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(binding)
	}
	c, session, err := enter(ctx, client, u.Account, r.PlayerID)
	if command == "source-refused" {
		if err == nil {
			c.raw.Close()
			return fmt.Errorf("source accepted target-owned player %d", r.PlayerID)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "the player is changing servers") && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "player is bound to another server") {
			return fmt.Errorf("expected an ownership refusal, got: %w", err)
		}
		fmt.Println("source refused target-owned player:", err)
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer c.raw.Close()
	switch command {
	case "apply":
		raw, err := c.call(msgid.MsgRehomeApply, mustMarshal(pb.MarshalRehomeApplyRequest(&pb.RehomeApplyRequest{To: 1001})))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		response, err := pb.UnmarshalRehomeApplyResponse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if response.Code != 0 || response.TransferID == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("apply: %+v", response)
		}
		if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for {
			select {
			case err := <-c.failed:
				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "accepted session disconnected:", err)
				return nil
			case <-c.packets: // 继续读掉推送，不能由探针自己的满队列挡住 EOF。
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return fmt.Errorf("accepted session stayed connected: %w", ctx.Err())
			}
		}
	case "spend", "verify":
		if command == "verify" {
			if session.ServingServerID != 1001 || session.ServerID != 1001 {
				return fmt.Errorf("binding on target: %+v", session)
			}
			count, err := addItems(c, 1)
			if err != nil || count != 11 {
				return fmt.Errorf("bag after move=%d, want 11: %v", count, err)
			}
		}
		// 同一键在换服两侧重发：余额和去重账本都必须跟着档走，不能重复扣款。
		raw, err := c.call(msgid.MsgWalletSpend, mustMarshal(pb.MarshalWalletSpendRequest(&pb.WalletSpendRequest{Key: "rehome-drill-spend", Amount: 7})))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		response, err := pb.UnmarshalWalletSpendResponse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if response.Code != 0 || response.Balance != 93 {
			return fmt.Errorf("wallet after %s=%+v, want balance 93", command, response)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%s player=%d serving=%d wallet=93 wallet_duplicate_safe=true\n", command, r.PlayerID, session.ServingServerID)
		return nil
	case "resume":
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("unknown command %s", command)
}
